stage_1_historical_general.purpose: historical general adaptation with bounded Ottocento exposure and modern-language preservation replay

stage_2_non_sonnet_poetry.purpose: historical non-sonnet poetry adaptation with stage-1 historical and modern-language replay

stage_3_sonnets.purpose: low-rate V7 sonnet specialization with stage-2 and modern-language replay

sampling_policy.broader: sample without exceeding the recorded work and author token-share ceilings; redistribute excess proportionally across uncapped eligible groups
sampling_policy.sonnets: sample V7-train identities only; harmonize epoch labels, cap author and epoch token exposure, and redistribute excess proportionally across uncapped eligible groups
sampling_policy.validation_test: count for audit only and never expose to a training sampler
